document_title: Food Safety and Standards (Ayurveda Aahar) Regulations, 2022
issuing_authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) & Ministry of AYUSH
snippet: Defines Ayurveda Aahar as food prepared in accordance with the recipes or processes or principles described in authoritative Ayurvedic books listed in Schedule A. It shall not include Ayurvedic drugs or proprietary medicines under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, nor can it include synthetic vitamins, minerals, amino acids, or isolated chemical compounds.
keywords: ayurveda aahar, fssai 2022 regulations, schedule a recipes, no synthetic additives, nutritional food

document_title: Food Safety and Standards (Ayurveda Aahar) Regulations, 2022
snippet: Every pack of Ayurveda Aahar shall display the dedicated 'AYURVEDA AAHAR' logo on the front of pack, along with advisory statements: target consumer group, nature of preparation, safe daily intake, and duration. Disease risk reduction claims are permitted only with prior FSSAI scientific panel approval; treatment, cure, or therapeutic claims are strictly prohibited.
keywords: ayurveda aahar logo, labeling advisory, disease claims prohibited, safe daily intake, front of pack
